card_T_animation_title: Hold to find your today’s Card
card_T_how2use_title: How to read (work with) Tarot Cards
card_T_how2use_text1: You are using the original Moonly Tarot deck. The illustrations and descriptions of the cards were created based on the French school of Dr. Papus. You can open the card of the day, find out its meaning and look at how its energy resonates with the events in your life. You can ask a specific question and then open the card, it will give you a hint. You can also use the descriptions of the cards to interpret your personal tarot spreads.
card_T_how2use_text2:
The deck has 79 cards: 23 Major arcana and 56 Minor arcana that include 16 court picture cards (Pages, Knights, Kings, Queens of four suits). The Major arcana are signs of higher powers that control our destinies. Their appearance in the spread makes any issue significant. The Minor arcana show events that our will can control. They are divided into four suits. Each of them defines a specific sphere of life:

Wands (rods, staves) — the sphere of the material, visible: body, specific objects, character, status, social role, visible part of the relationship.

Cups (goblets) — the sphere of feelings, experiences, emotions.

Swords — the sphere of mental work: plans, assessments, worldview, unconscious patterns, fears.

Pentacles (discs, coins) — represent our energy contribution within different areas of life and what we get due to our actions, most often, it's about energy or money.
card_T_how2use_text3:
The upright and reversed meanings of the same card are different. Often a reversed card has the opposite meaning but there can be exceptions. For a better understanding, we recommend that you read both meanings and then focus on the one that you got. Some cards have private aspects that should only be considered when a question concerns a particular topic and fits the meaning.

Each card has a degree of auspiciousness. This number will help you quickly understand how favorable the development of events predicted by cards is.
card_T_how2use_text4: Tarot can become a loyal and sincere guide on your way. This tool is charged with light energy that will help you to understand the lessons of fate, carefully steer in the right direction, highlight important issues and become a vital guide on the path of inner transformation. Don't be afraid to turn to the cards for advice. However, remember: they only give clues but the decision is always yours. After all, we have a divine right — the right of free will, which rules over everything.
card_T_brief_manyMeanings: The card has multiple meanings. Choose the one that suits your question best.
card_T_01_MAG_D1_text: An idea given from above comes to mind. That idea chose a person to be applied in the world and make it better with their help. They already have everything that is needed to implement that idea. What is missing now will come at the right time. If the person takes everything into their own hands and starts taking action, they will achieve some positive results eventually. People around usually admire a Magician’s idea and approve of it. The scope of an idea and an area of life it concerns depend on a question: the card can symbolize a good idea concerning everyday matters or a big idea in important spreads.
card_T_01_MAG_D1_rec_text: Wait for the idea to come to you in the near future. If you already have an idea, implement it — this world needs it, so the space will support you. The decision not to follow the idea won’t have any negative consequences but if you put it into action, it will improve your life.
card_T_01_MAG_A1_text: A flawed idea. A person had everything to implement their plans but they happened to ruin everything with their own hands. Perhaps, they removed something important from the idea, added unnecessary details, or talked too much about it. It is also possible that they’ve been planning for too long, waiting for luck, or directed their attention outwards instead of an implementation process.
card_T_01_MAG_A1_rec_text: Think about how you could’ve killed your idea — there is still an opportunity to fix everything and implement it.
card_T_02_HPT_D1_text: A sudden insight, revelation, clarity. The truth is revealed at the moment when it’s time to see it. A person suddenly sees a situation as it is, which changes their life. Often, an insight comes quietly, without unnecessary emotions, as if the eyes suddenly opened up. It becomes possible to see the truth. It can concern significant moments or everyday matters depending on a question. The Popess also represents the female energy, consciousness and subconsciousness, an ability to enter the state of flow.
card_T_02_HPT_D1_rec_text: You already have true knowledge, or it will come soon. Accept it in order to live on. Trust yourself — you’ll get it right.
card_T_02_HPT_A1_text: A person deliberately blocks knowledge of the truth because it doesn’t serve their interest. Revelation destroys their idea of life, does not live up to their expectations and vision of the world. Accepting it is hard and painful, so it is easier to deny it deep in one’s mind.
card_T_02_HPT_A1_rec_text: Do not resist knowledge, embrace it. Sooner or later, it will come to you and make you accept it anyway.
card_T_03_3oW_D1_text: A successful investment that will bring desired results in the future. A process that started recently leads to success. It is favorable in terms of social status, increases your social value as well as makes external processes more comfortable. Work-wise, this can mean a considerable improvement in working conditions and commute, an increase in comfort, or career growth. As for relationships, the card means a step towards improving the external component: how partners communicate, how they interact, their actions towards one another. These can be the right steps taken together or mutual agreements. The card promises success in all body and health procedures. The character of a person gets more adaptive, allowing them to better show themselves in life.
card_T_03_3oW_D1_rec_text: Take the right steps that will open up new prospects for you. If you continue to invest in this process, you will get what you want.
card_T_03_3oW_A1_text: An unsuccessful investment that will not bring the desired result. Not realizing what they are doing, a person invests in something that won’t be crowned with success. Or the result will be less impressive than expected. In a relationship, the card can mean that your actions won’t influence your partner the way you want it.
card_T_03_3oW_A1_rec_text: Give up this undertaking, you are just wasting your energy.
card_T_04_3oC_D1_text: A one-time victory, one-time success. A person got lucky because everything worked out for them. They won though they could easily lose, and that kept them out of trouble. If a question concerns a one-time event, the card predicts success. The difficulties to be faced won't have negative consequences as well as won’t affect significant aspects of life.
card_T_04_3oC_D1_rec_text: Be grateful for what happened. However, you need to understand that this won’t always be the case — the card means a one-time success.
card_T_04_3oC_A1_text: Anxiety, sadness. A certain life period is coming to an end. It won't be the same anymore, and that can cause melancholy. Also, the card means that all the difficulties, actions, and mistakes will have consequences. This time, you won’t get lucky, so any argument won’t go unnoticed. If you managed to get away with revealing your true character earlier, now you can get yourself into trouble.
card_T_04_3oC_A1_rec_text: If you don’t want something to end, there is still an opportunity to fix everything and save the situation. Don’t rely on pure luck, in this situation it will not come to your rescue.
card_T_05_3oS_D1_text: Ill-conceived ideas, lack of a clear plan. A person overlooked something, so they faced difficulties. Probably, in this situation it was not possible to get all the necessary information, that’s why one has to improvise.
card_T_05_3oS_D1_rec_text: Try to think everything over and plan ahead of time. If it is not possible, play it by ear, focusing on the moment.
card_T_05_3oS_A1_text: Life full of illusions, fantasies, and delusions. A person refuses to see the truth and take everything as it is, because they do not want to deal with it. They deny the true state of affairs and mix up illusions with reality. The truth is obvious but inconvenient, so it's easier to lie to yourself.
card_T_05_3oS_A1_rec_text: Accept reality, whatever it is — this is the only way you can move on.
card_T_06_3oP_D1_text: A new process began some time ago, and it has already brought some results. Or, a new stage of an old process has begun, which is already bearing fruit. It's time to draw conclusions and make further plans on their basis. In a relationship, it is now clear how a new beginning manifests itself. One can notice what influence the new process has on their character. The time to correct actions and choose a further path has come.
card_T_06_3oP_D1_rec_text: You already know where this process is leading you. Draw conclusions and plan the next steps.
card_T_06_3oP_A1_text: A person puts off drawing conclusions as they feel they won’t like them. They refuse to plan further actions in the hope that the result will change over time. This behavior is more typical of a child who waits out an unpleasant situation and hopes for a good outcome for no reason.
card_T_06_3oP_A1_rec_text: Accept the truth. This will allow you to see things clearly and consider further actions carefully.
card_T_07_HRT_D1_text:
New people, situations, and experiences for soul development. These processes teach a person important lessons in terms of destiny. Often, the card stands for the “papal union”. This is a relationship in which partners must teach each other something important, and pick up all the necessary qualities. Usually, destiny brings together very different, seemingly incompatible people. As a result, irresistible attraction arises between them, and that doesn't allow them to drift apart until they learn their lessons. Such a connection goes hand in hand with tension, difficulties, and constant work on yourself. It’s designed to break stereotypes and teach by example of another person that one can live and act differently. Various skills are essential for the soul experience.

The Pope can symbolize a new relationship, or the beginning of such a life stage when it is important to learn something from each other in a relationship you already have. The Papal alliance concerns not only romantic relationships, but also any interaction between people which implies learning: a teacher — a student, an employer — an employee, a parent — a child, a more experienced colleague — a less experienced one.
card_T_07_HRT_D1_rec_text: Learn, embrace the experience you are destined to get. Or teach someone else, pass on knowledge that you already have.
card_T_07_HRT_A1_text: An attempt to leave the papal alliance, take an easier path and avoid difficulties. A person gives up important experiences that are necessary for their soul's growth. They are trying to get out of the process without learning lessons of destiny.
card_T_07_HRT_A1_rec_text: Accept all the necessary lessons and go through them. Do not resist the “papal union”. If the question doesn’t concern any relationships, then the card recommends drawing conclusions, understanding what you need to learn, what emotions to work with, what mistakes to analyze and not to make again.
card_T_08_6oW_D1_text: The social area where there is stability and, at the same time, a creative component. Work-wise, this means stability, status, as well as creating something new, contributing yourself. In a relationship, the card implies a certain status and area of responsibility but also respect for the freedom and interests of a partner, flexible agreements. As for character, it means all-around development, the ability to show yourself in different situations. The Six of Wands symbolizes a higher standard of living, the ability to give yourself to processes and enjoy them.
card_T_08_6oW_D1_rec_text: Create a comfortable social environment by reinforcing the part that is missing. If you need more stability, establish rules and agreements. If you lack creativity, come up with new suggestions, your own solutions. The card says that you can definitely do it.
card_T_08_6oW_D2_text: A slow movement towards a goal. This can be good if slow steps are important for the process, but unfavorable if the movement is too slow, or it is just a simple statement of fact. To understand, you should look at the other cards in the spread, or ask the cards clarifying questions.
card_T_08_6oW_D2_rec_text: Keep moving. If the pace is important for the process, try to speed up and reach your goal faster.
card_T_08_6oW_A1_text: Bad experience of the past makes it difficult to assess the situation accurately. A person subconsciously expects that events will play out like similar scenarios, and draws conclusions based on that. Thus, it might delude the person not allowing them to use opportunities and act appropriately. The card promises neither a better, nor worse outcome, but it assures that everything will turn out differently.
card_T_08_6oW_A1_rec_text: Do not compare the current situation with the past. Act from the present moment.
card_T_09_6oC_D1_text:
Nostalgia, memories. They are usually accompanied by a surge of emotions and a slight sadness about the past. The card can take on a negative meaning if a person gets stuck in this state for a long time. They cling to memories and stop moving forward.

The specific meaning in esoteric spreads: past lives.
card_T_09_6oC_D1_rec_text: Don’t live in the past, don’t look back so often. In case memories can become a resource and give you strength to improve the situation, the card advises you to recall how things were before.
card_T_09_6oC_A1_text: A valuable skill or experience from the past that can be adapted to a current situation and implemented in new conditions. It can concern the format of work, ideas, behavior, special skills. In the past, a person had already mastered the knowledge and skills that can help them now. The specific meaning in esoteric spreads: past lives.
card_T_09_6oC_A1_rec_text: You have valuable baggage from the past. Think about these skills, transform them and create something new to achieve your current goals.
card_T_10_6oS_D1_text:
The situation when you overestimated yourself and did not get the result you’d expected. Perhaps, you misunderstood something in the first place, and therefore, your self-esteem suffered — you were put in your place. A useful card that shows objective reality, but one can accept the truth in an uncomfortable and painful way.

The specific meaning of the card for certain questions: a road, way to somewhere.
card_T_10_6oS_D1_rec_text: Be ready for things to turn out differently. The results will be limited and less impressive. Take it for granted, do not blame anyone and draw conclusions to move on.
card_T_10_6oS_A1_text:
Successful constructive negotiations which lead to a solution that suits both sides. Such negotiations imply being interested in understanding each other, a desire not only to speak your mind but also to be heard, accept the point of view of the other and find a common solution. How favorable the card will mostly depend on a person’s ability to negotiate skillfully.

Specific aspect in certain issues: signing a contract.
card_T_10_6oS_A1_rec_text: Listen to your interlocutor’s opinion, conduct high-level negotiations and try to reach a consensus — a result that will suit everyone.
card_T_11_6oP_D1_text: A gift from destiny. There is a chance to prove yourself at a new level and take hold of it. It does not come by pure chance — a person invested their strength and resources, worked, developed, walked towards this goal. As a gift for their efforts, destiny gives them an excellent opportunity to thrive. However, you can’t relax in this situation: if you do not take advantage of the chance and put yourself into it, it will disappear. Also, in some specific questions, the card can symbolize a gift.
card_T_11_6oP_D1_rec_text: This is a gift opportunity from destiny, seize it. How things will develop further depends only on how you take up this opportunity. If there isn’t such an opportunity in your life now, and your question is really difficult, then the card advises you to keep going and wait for a gift situation.
card_T_11_6oP_A1_text: Obsession with one option. A person has a clear vision of how it should be and blindly insists that it’s the only right choice. They see the other options but do not want to even consider them since they seem unacceptable. In the moment of obsession, they do not realize they’re being narrow-minded and too persistent. It can be an obsession with a job, a person, a specific task, intention, or idea. The scale depends on the question: everyday matters or serious life patterns.
card_T_11_6oP_A1_rec_text: Don’t limit yourself and rely only on one option. Consider other possibilities. If the question is about the future, the card warns that you can cling to one option, and advises you not to let this happen.
card_T_12_LOV_D1_text:
A choice. When a soul comes into this world, it has two programs: a personal one — the tasks and lessons that the higher self has planned to go through in this life, and a social one — rules, social status, relationships with people. The realization of the personal program gives a feeling of being in the right place, satisfaction, joy of life. The social program provides opportunities, material abundance, and belonging to society. One feels happy and fulfilled when both programs are realized. However, the personal program is more important — this is the path to go all the way down, regardless of the circumstances.

At different life stages, different programs and areas come to the forefront. At such moments, destiny forces a person to make a choice. One of the options is always in favor of the social program — it is convenient, profitable, and approved. The second option can’t be explained by logic but the heart is drawn to it as this is the right option, the realization of a personal program. The choice between them is a kind of test that allows a person to understand where they are and what is more important for them: the path of the heart or the outer image. At a crossroads, they can make a decision only on their own.

A choice is often not obvious and very difficult to make. If one decides to follow their inner voice and the path of the heart, they make the right choice and pass the test. After that, the Chariot card comes to them — new opportunities, realization, success. If they make the wrong choice, the Tower card follows — everything obsolete and unnecessary is being destroyed.

The specific aspect in esoteric spreads: love under the Major Arcana. This is love given from above so that the soul can experience high vibrations. It comes to mature, highly developed souls that are ready to learn significant lessons. This love does not imply anything but pure feelings, without a desire to possess a person, start a relationship, get married, without any expectations and demands. The lesson of high love means that a person knows how to separate love and dependence. There is only a strong feeling that unites two people into a single whole and never ends even if they do not see each other. In most cases, love under the Major Arcana has social limitations and difficulties (concerning religion, age, status). In this spread, the Lovers also mean a choice — to choose hard love only for the sake of feelings or to give it up because it’s more convenient. This is an extremely rare meaning of the card.
card_T_12_LOV_D1_rec_text: Make a choice with your heart. Choose the truth — what your inner voice tells you, no matter how difficult it may seem.
card_T_12_LOV_A1_text: A person does not make a choice and puts off making a decision in order to see how things will turn out. It seems that it will be more clear which path to choose then. In this situation, they are trying to walk along two different roads at the same time keeping both options open. However, there’s no point in doing that — it won't get any easier and you will still have to make a choice. The longer one waits, the more difficult it will be to decide.
card_T_12_LOV_A1_rec_text: Do not delay making a decision. Opt for something now, otherwise, it will be even more difficult later.
card_T_13_CHA_D1_text:
Some time ago, you faced a serious choice and made the right decision — you followed your heart. Now your life is speeding up. All the undertakings that take place during this period are the most favorable and necessary for your development. A quick pace can be challenging and exhausting but it isn’t time to rest — you need to accept events and make the best out of everything that comes to your life. The Chariot implies that events follow each other and bring the best result. Slowing down the pace and events can lead to negative karma.

The specific meaning in questions concerning the success of a one-time event in the future: a one-time victory. In this case, everything will turn out in the best possible way, luck is on your side.
card_T_13_CHA_D1_rec_text: Make the most of your Chariot of life. Throw yourself into new beginnings and current processes as hard as you can. The more you do now, the more it will benefit you. If your question is about the future, wait for the Chariot to put your plans into action.
card_T_13_CHA_A1_text: A person can’t keep up with the pace of the Chariot and tries to slow things down. The speed is too fast, so they get out of processes trying to avoid the hustle and bustle. In a relationship, this can mean that things are moving too quickly and one of the partners deliberately keeps distance in order to slow them down. Work-wise, this might be an attempt to give up something in order to ease the workload. However, now is the best time to take advantage of your opportunities. You will have to get involved in these processes anyway sooner or later but under less favorable circumstances.
card_T_13_CHA_A1_rec_text: Do not try to slow things down. They will reach you anyway but in a less favorable situation. Take action now.
card_T_14_7oW_D1_text:
Сonversations. In esoteric spreads, these are conversations that bring a person closer to realizing their potential. When one talks about something important and meaningful, they put energy into it, which materializes their intention in the real world. This is a natural stage of talking about your plans when it is too early to act. If you do not mull it over and speak it to the end, you may not get a complete picture of what is happening, get lost in your desires and eventually realize you had to act differently.

In non-esoteric, everyday matters, the card means a constructive conversation. In relationships and work, it advises to find out something, clarify, discuss. The outcome depends on how people manage to talk with each other and what they decide.

The specific aspect in particular questions: a word. Perhaps you need to pay attention to a specific word that you use in your work or communication. For example, replace a word in an ad, slogan, text. It could also be that a misunderstood word said earlier offended another person.

Another specific aspect: gossip. One is drowning in conversations, reports, and wrong judgments.

Choose the meaning of the card that fits your question best.
card_T_14_7oW_D1_rec_text: Talk, clarify any unclear points. Constructive conversations will be the key to success in your case.
card_T_14_7oW_A1_text: A person avoids conversations because they don’t believe in their success. Perhaps, they have already brought up this topic but did not achieve the desired result and gave up. However, the situation requires conversations, and this card suggests they bear fruit. The situation is not hopeless if you choose the right time and appropriate tone for communicating. The conversation might not lead to the result you expect, but it sure will be beneficial fate-wise.
card_T_14_7oW_A1_rec_text: Don't walk away from the conversation. Talk the situation over with an interlocutor in order to come up with a common solution.
card_T_15_7oC_D1_text:
The feeling of love. Each person needs love and creates a subconscious image of their ideal partner. When they meet somebody who fits this image, their astral body starts releasing love energy — they fall in love. This is a strong and beautiful feeling, but it is not given from above — a person creates it themselves, that’s why they have a lot of illusions. They expect their partner to be exactly the way they want to see them.

As a result, after some time, when the partner starts showing their true self and doesn’t live up to an ideal image, it is getting more and more difficult to love them. There comes a feeling everything was different before, although only the inner perception has changed. This is how falling in love ends. It may be followed either by a break-up or the emergence of a deeper feeling of love without any illusions. However, the love of the Seven of Cups is also beautiful — it brings out the best in a person, changes them for the better. Its nature is typical of humans.
card_T_15_7oC_D1_rec_text: Let yourself love, learn its lessons. This feeling has a lot of potential.
card_T_15_7oC_D2_text: Illusions. A person prefers to see what they want, and it hides the reality from them. Perhaps, they are not aware of all the details, don’t look into the situation, or just refuse to think straight.
card_T_15_7oC_D2_rec_text: Get rid of illusions. Rely only on real facts and draw conclusions from the current state of affairs.
card_T_15_7oC_A1_text: Lack of love. A person is suffering from a lack of emotions and no proof of love from their partner. Work-wise, there might be a feeling that one is not appreciated and their work doesn’t pay off. This lack of feelings forces them to take proactive steps to get love and a sense of importance. It often happens through pain and tears, one can even provoke quarrels and scandals in order to get at least some emotions, even negative ones.
card_T_15_7oC_A1_rec_text: Take action to feel loved and significant. Take the initiative to improve the situation and get satisfied.
card_T_16_7oS_D1_text: Willpower, the ability to pull yourself together. The card speaks of having a backbone, leadership qualities, the ability to think it through, to work out your next steps, and come up with a backup plan if necessary. This is a positive card in terms of work issues and personal growth. However, if it concerns relationships, it is less favorable: a person is trying to control everything, impose their own point of view, manipulate. Constant tension, an attempt to keep track of everything can lead to health problems and psychosomatic disorders.
card_T_16_7oS_D1_rec_text: Analyze, consider all the options, mull over the issue thoroughly. Everything will work out for you if you take on a leadership role and act right. However, in matters concerning relationships or health, the card recommends letting go of excessive control — this will make the situation less stressful.
card_T_16_7oS_A1_text: A person can’t control the situation because someone else is doing it. So, they act as an executor who has to obey someone else's will. Or they don’t want to take responsibility to make decisions and outsource this to other people.
card_T_16_7oS_A1_rec_text: Avoiding responsibility can cause problems in all areas of life. Don't run away from decision-making and active participation in the creation of your own life.
card_T_17_7oP_D1_text: Financial energy. There are more money matters in this situation than it seemed initially. This is a favorable card in terms of work and profit. It promises big money. However, when it comes to purchases and expenses, one might spend more than expected. In the spreads about health and character, the card means strong personal energy, vitality and stamina.
card_T_17_7oP_D1_rec_text: Work-wise — earn money, make a profitable investment. You definitely have an opportunity to do this now. Health-wise: do something that will give you energy and strength.
card_T_17_7oP_D2_text: If the question concerns relations, the card is unfavorable: one of the partners has a flaw that the second one cannot accept. This negative personality trait is so significant that they will end up either breaking up or drifting apart. In any matters related to relationships and emotions, this meaning can be interpreted as “everything is good, except for one thing”.
card_T_17_7oP_D2_rec_text: Admit that there is a flaw in your partner or you, accept it and think about what to do to come to terms with it if it’s possible.
card_T_17_7oP_A1_text:
Difficulties with harnessing the energy that is coming into life. In the spreads about money: a person can’t cope with a new financial level, and as a result, they waste money and lose their job. Another option is when people get star-struck, waste money, brag about their position since subconsciously it is unnatural for them. In a relationship, the card stirs up a feeling that this is an uncomfortable level for a person, which they don’t deserve. That can often become a reason that people unintentionally provoke conflicts, jealousy, nagging in order to prove their innocence to themselves. As for work, a person either does not cope with their duties or is certain they will fail anyway. Therefore, they subconsciously create situations in which they have to give up, leave.

However, the Seven of Pentacles means that now you have all the chances to master a new level and deal with whatever comes into your life. It is not external factors, but your own patterns and blocks that stand in your way. If the transition to a new level has occurred recently, the card may mean a temporary feeling of confusion that will disappear soon, and a person will get used to the flow of abundance.

The specific aspect in particular issues: tears. They can become a way to release tension when one isn’t ready to accept the situation.
card_T_17_7oP_A1_rec_text: Don’t let your negative experience from the past guide you. Relax and accept what comes to you. You can handle it. To better harness your energy, you can do breathing practices or relaxation rituals.
card_T_18_AoW_D1_text:
The beginning of a new process that can improve life in terms of its social part. It concerns the conditions of the processes, their comfort, and the external communication of people. The main condition here is the desire of a person to develop. In order for the card to fulfill its positive potential, it is necessary to invest energy, put in a lot of effort and change the visible side of life for the better.

The arrival of the Ace of Wands may not be obvious and imperceptible: a person doesn't know yet if their undertaking will bring results. The scale of the event depends on the choice: small things that will add convenience and comfort or global life issues. This is not a fateful card — there is no need to implement every Ace of Wands, as they appear quite regularly. In questions about work, the card shows that there are opportunities for growth and establishing your authority, if you try and do your best.
card_T_18_AoW_D1_rec_text: Use this opportunity to change your life for the better. Your efforts will bring positive results.
card_T_18_AoW_A1_text: Wrong actions that got in the way of the natural positive course of events. Perhaps, a person rushed things or broke written or unwritten rules. These can be late arrivals, mistakes, inappropriate communication style, breaking promises, or other negative things in terms of social interactions. The card says you can try to fix the situation but a positive outcome can’t be guaranteed.
card_T_18_AoW_A1_rec_text: Stop breaking rules and take your time. Destiny wants you to correct your actions, then things can still get better.
card_T_19_AoC_D1_text: A moment of joy, euphoria, delight. The scale depends on the question: an everyday situation or an important event in life. The card doesn’t have a long-term effect, it means a shallow process and does not say how events will develop further. Emotional uplift can create illusions when a person doesn’t pay attention to reality, makes illogical decisions they will regret later. Such reckless actions might lead to failure. Also, the Ace of Cups can reflect a state of motivation and dedication with little logic and constructive action.
card_T_19_AoC_D1_rec_text: Pamper yourself, live in this state of euphoria. Enjoy the process but don't make important decisions.
card_T_19_AoC_A1_text: Intense joy followed by frustration and disappointment. Something went wrong. How unfavorable the situation depends on the significance of the question. It can be just frustration or deeper emotions, even depression. Usually, the card’s effect is short-term, if a person doesn’t make themselves feel worse on their own.
card_T_19_AoC_A1_rec_text: Experience all negative emotions and let go of the situation. Don't bottle up your feelings, but don't drown yourself in them either. Stay in this state and then move on.
card_T_20_AoS_D1_text: The emergence of an idea that possesses a person. This idea does not come from above, it is created by the mind, so it may not coincide with the path outlined by fate. The person comes up with a plan that should bring results. The idea can occupy all their thoughts, they want to hit the goal as soon as possible. There’s a feeling that achieving it will tackle a lot of life problems. The card does not say whether it’s a good idea or not, just states that one is obsessed with it.
card_T_20_AoS_D1_rec_text: Evaluate the feasibility of your idea. Don't obsess over it or shut yourself off from other opportunities. If the question requires willpower and putting in a lot of effort, the card advises you to set a clear goal, make it your priority and strive for achieving it.
card_T_20_AoS_A1_text:
Losing an idea that seemed very significant. A person was obsessed with their idea, wanted to realize it, but everything collapsed all of a sudden. It is clear now that it was impossible. The card might go hand in hand with a lot of pain, negative emotions and even depression. The reversed Ace of Swords comes up when the idea does not fit into the destiny scenario and does not belong to the higher purpose. Other possible reasons: one rushes things up, sets too many conditions for implementation, or, vice versa, deprives the idea of its sense.

The specific aspect in questions that imply this meaning: pregnancy.

The second aspect: suicide.

The third aspect: studying.
card_T_20_AoS_A1_rec_text: Come to terms with the fact that it’s impossible to put your idea into action now and move on. Perhaps, if you reconsider your conditions for it, it will get easier to implement it.
card_T_21_AoP_D1_text: Maximum luck, a lot of positive moments. This is not a one-time success, but a long period when things happen in the best possible way. Its duration is unknown. The card comes after Justice when one has already untied the karmic knot and tackled a number of difficult problems they couldn’t get down to for a long time. Whatever you’re up to, luck will be on your side. During this period, it is favorable to start solving other difficulties since it is easier to do it now.
card_T_21_AoP_D1_rec_text: Solve an old problem to attract maximum luck into your life. If the question is about the future, wait for the Ace of Pentacles: the issue you are asking about cannot be tackled without luck.
card_T_21_AoP_A1_text: A person is obsessed with money and prioritizes it. They seem to get good luck in a material form sacrificing all other aspects of life. For example, one’s income increases but conditions, environment, emotional state leave much to be desired. This can be a life period when a person puts money first intentionally because it is necessary now. Also, the reversed card can indicate a hostile attitude. A person does something without putting their heart, energy and effort into the process. They do not listen to their inner voice but act automatically.
card_T_21_AoP_A1_rec_text: Do not get hung up on money, trust your inner voice and the needs of the soul. If the question concerns money and at the moment it’s your top priority, keep on acting the same way, but decide how long you have to wait to achieve your goal.
card_T_22_2oW_D1_text: A situation when it is impossible to act in the old way. One needs new skills they don’t have now. It can irritate and anger or make you blame others for your failure. The card rarely comes out of the blue. Usually, there are some signs that it is time to learn new things but a person holds on to the past and ignores them. One can see the card as a negative one but it has a positive meaning in a broad sense because, with the help of such situations, destiny forces the person to develop for their own good. It might concern professional skills, new knowledge, different behavior, new character traits.
card_T_22_2oW_D1_rec_text: Learn new things, acquire new skills.
card_T_22_2oW_A1_text: New opportunities for further development. In this situation, destiny does not make a person learn, but it encourages them to acquire skills they will need in the future. It can come to you in the form of new information or a proposal that caught your eye. It may not be obvious at first what kind of results the undertaking will bring. However, if you follow your gut feeling and seize the opportunities, you will enjoy great benefits in the time to come. If you ignore the chance, you can find yourself in such a situation in the future when these skills won't be enough.
card_T_22_2oW_A1_rec_text: Focus on all the offers you receive. Take the opportunity to learn something new, acquire new skills.
card_T_23_2oC_D1_text: Love, enchantment. This is a good card that describes the beginning of a relationship, when your heart beats faster, a partner seems perfect and all your thoughts are about them. If the question does not concern romantic relationships, then the card means enchantment, being “on the same wavelength” with a person, city, job, some significant thing. In such a situation, everything seems to be perfect and you feel like you have everything you have ever dreamed of. Also, the card can mean an inner feeling of self-satisfaction, pride in your actions. However, the card isn't deep — it describes a short emotional period but does not promise its development into more serious feelings. It is characterized by illusions, lack of awareness, actions led by emotions.
card_T_23_2oC_D1_rec_text: Enjoy the moment, let yourself have this wonderful experience, but do not confuse it with deeper feelings.
card_T_23_2oC_A1_text: Fighting and arguing over meaningless things. Their reason lies in inner complaints and hurt feelings that accumulated over time, and a person is not even aware of their existence. It can also be inner dissatisfaction, excessive criticism and high expectations of yourself.
card_T_23_2oC_A1_rec_text: Deal with your inner complaints, speak and work them out — they are the reasons for your conflicts.
card_T_24_2oS_D1_text: A tandem of two people who understand each other well on a particular issue. This is a positive card for business matters and work. However, in questions about relationships, it means that partners see each other as companions, close people, but not as lovers. There is neither passion nor emotions between them. Also, the card can reflect a person's inner process. They were torn between two opposite points of view and could not decide which one was correct, finally, they managed to find a solution that settled the internal conflict.
card_T_24_2oS_D1_rec_text: Find the right partner, do business together.
card_T_24_2oS_A1_text: A conflict between two people. In another situation, they could create a tandem and successfully complement each other, but now there is a confrontation between them because each is trying to enter the territory of the other and impose their opinion. It can also mean an inner conflict when a person is on the fence about something. That’s why their actions are inconsistent and often contradictory.
card_T_24_2oS_A1_rec_text: In case of a conflict with another person, split areas of responsibility and agree not to criticize each other’s actions. In case of an inner conflict — take a look at the situation from another angle and come to a final decision.
card_T_25_2oP_D1_text:
The emergence of options that don’t seem perfect. A person has different opportunities but they don’t like any of them. It can be confusing and one doesn't know what to think about what is coming into their life and how to deal with it. The card means that the person does not have a full picture of what they want. They can’t prioritize, so they are torn between different options.

The specific aspect in matters relating to documents, contracts: mixed up documentation that can lead to problems.
card_T_25_2oP_D1_rec_text: Channel your energy into the thoughts about what you really want. Decide what matters most to you. You can also find a “model” that is close to your idea of perfection so that you use it to visualize your goal better.
card_T_25_2oP_A1_text: Unfinished tasks that make one a fate’s debtor. These are unpleasant things that a person does not like, so they avoid them, postpone until the last moment. They pile up and over time can develop into a karmic knot, which will cause real problems. It may also mean that in this matter something is not ready yet and needs working on.
card_T_25_2oP_A1_rec_text: Finish what you have been postponing for a long time. Do not delay — fate will still force you to learn these lessons but at a higher cost.
card_T_26_EMS_D1_text:
The card is responsible for the global tasks of the material world — relationships between people, partnerships, parent-child relationships and procreation. At this moment in life, fate requires a person to act to help them develop the feminine or masculine part of themselves.

From the point of view of the Empress, the inner female part is responsible for building harmonious relationships. It aims to increase energy, reveal inner strength and sexuality, establish contact with a partner and maintain constructive dialogue in favorable circumstances. She can help develop relationships and take them to the next level. The card can lead a woman through different relationships so that she gains experience when interacting with various people, as well as wisdom and karma to meet the partner she needs. The Empress is incredibly supportive of pregnant women.

The inner male part is responsible for work and implementation in the outer world. She can help transfer the family to a new social level, provide conditions for harmonious development and help make contacts and support negotiations. The Empress' card sends money, necessary information and career growth that can be used for the benefit of the family. If there is no family, the Empress encourages you to think about having it and plan for the future.

The Empress encourages a healthy, friendly, humane attitude towards the world, kindness to all its inhabitants, nature and actions that benefit others. And vice versa, it stops everything that harms other living creatures, their development and life. In work matters, this card means a fair attitude towards people: caring for employees, creating good conditions for colleagues, attention to customers and good manners.
card_T_26_EMS_D1_rec_text: Invest energy in the current task of material life. Do what the Empress expects of you. Its appearance in the spread suggests that this is an important topic that needs to be worked on. Activate the inner energy and manifest it outwards. Focus on harmonizing relationships. Give more attention to the family, people around you and direct resources towards them. The card recommends a healthy, friendly attitude, courtesy and care in matters relating to interactions with people.
card_T_26_EMS_A1_text: A movement against the Empress. Actions that harm the relationship or the development of the female or male parts. It may be an attempt to escape from problems, cause harm or deceive others. The Empress can be angry with behavior that humiliates a partner, being withdrawn instead of having constructive dialogue and attempting to solve everything on their own. It also becomes reversed when a person avoids relationships for a long time, doesn't give enough attention to the close ones, spends resources wastefully and does not invest in the family. She also punishes for disrespectful attitude toward women and promiscuous relationships.
card_T_26_EMS_A1_rec_text: Correct what the Empress doesn't like. Analyze your actions and determine how you could've angered her — it's not too late to change things around.
card_T_27_HMT_D1_text: The moment in life when a higher power transfers a person to a new, higher level. It feels like a loss of energy when you have enough energy only for basic needs. There is no strength and desire for active action, because the energy flow is directed to inner work, reevaluation. One wants to do something calming, spend time alone. There are no negative emotions or apathy in this process — only a peaceful calm state. Nothing special usually happens during this period in life, all external processes stop.
card_T_27_HMT_D1_rec_text: You need to be in silence now. Relax, don't try to make a fuss on purpose. Breathe out and let the natural development process take place. Now is not the best time for any endeavors.
card_T_27_HMT_D2_text: Reevaluation one realizes later. It seems as if a person switches off a specific area of life, loses interest in it and shifts their attention to other areas. Then the period ends, and they focus on this area again. Suddenly, the person is active and wants to express themselves. And when they get re-engaged in the activity, they notice that their attitude to certain issues has changed. Their preferences, opinions and reactions to different incentives are no longer the same. There happened a reevaluation of all values.
card_T_27_HMT_D2_rec_text: Time for reassessment. Accept this natural process with ease and don't engage in unneeded activity in the area that doesn't interest you anymore.
card_T_27_HMT_A1_text: An attempt to fake an activity when there is no need to. This fuss won’t bring any results — only irritation and harm as you’ve almost run out of energy. If you keep on like this, you can have health problems that will make you calm down anyway.
card_T_27_HMT_A1_rec_text: Stop making a fuss, it does no good to you. Now you need to relax and postpone active actions for a more favorable period.
card_T_28_5oP_D1_text: Taking risks at the wrong time. A person overestimated themselves and did something beyond their capabilities. Now they are faced with obstacles and challenges that are very difficult to overcome. If you put together all your resources and go through a number of difficulties, then your success is a sure thing. However, the path will be so difficult that it is highly unlikely that you will get to the end.
card_T_28_5oP_D1_rec_text: Your question requires a lot of effort and makes you step on a path full of obstacles. Either don't go there, or be ready not to stop and go to the end, no matter what happens. This is the only way to achieve what you want. Think carefully if it's worth it.
card_T_28_5oP_D2_text: Stupidity, whim. One realizes that their efforts were not worth it. A person overdid themselves and lost time and energy, as a result.
card_T_28_5oP_D2_rec_text: Accept that you've overestimated your abilities and things didn't turn out successfully. It's a lesson that needs to be learned and moved on from.
card_T_28_5oP_A1_text: Deficit thinking. A person sees only bad things, focuses only on what they did not get, what they were not given. They evaluate everything through comparison to others and do not notice the good. Focusing on the negative can become a personality trait that is difficult to get rid of.
card_T_28_5oP_A1_rec_text: Change the way you think. Deliberately focus on the positive. Over time, it will get easier to do this.
card_T_29_5oS_D1_text: A state of rage, aggression. A person crossed the line, which shouldn’t be crossed, and succumbed to the destructive energy. They say and do things that hurt others. In this state, one loses their self-control, and the inner Devil comes out. In a moment of rage, it seems that you need to break up relationships, connections, quit your job. The Five of Swords doesn’t let you create and negotiate. The only way to save the situation is to end the conversation, cut off contacts, go to the Four of Swords, into the void, emptiness.
card_T_29_5oS_D1_rec_text: At any cost, get out of the state of aggression and destruction. Try to restrain your inner Devil. If a person you are talking to goes into a rage, put an end to that communication. A conversation in such a state will do no good.
card_T_29_5oS_D2_text: One started doing something they are not ready for. If they continue to do this now, they will fail.
card_T_29_5oS_D2_rec_text: You are trying to succeed in something you are not ready for. You can’t help but give up. It is better to stop now and postpone it for a better time.
card_T_29_5oS_A1_text: Something bad turns up in a person's worldview and character. They blame everyone for their troubles, take out their anger on those who cannot stand up for themselves, and behave inappropriately. In matters of health, the card means a life-threatening illness. Where it does not concern character or health, the card speaks of fanaticism, misperceptions and behavior.
card_T_29_5oS_A1_rec_text: Protect your field from such people. If you notice any negative traits in your own character, ask for help. Be mindful and attentive to yourself, and try to figure out what you are doing wrong. Do not cross the line, do not get fanatical in any area of your life.
card_T_30_5oC_D1_text:
A new source of valuable information has appeared in the field — something or someone that is more knowledgeable about the topic. This comes in the form of advice, consultation, information read or heard by chance. This knowledge is definitely useful but the card does not guarantee that you will be able to apply it correctly.

In the spreads about relationships, the meaning of the card is more complicated. If the situation concerns only one specific area of knowledge, then one of the partners knows it better and helps the other — it’s favorable. If the question concerns relationships in general, then one of the partners considers the other as a teacher. Because of this, the relationship misses an important part which is intimacy with a loved one, the energy of love and passion.
card_T_30_5oC_D1_rec_text: Get new knowledge. Ask someone who knows this area for more information. Have a consultation with a specialist. This will give you important knowledge to find the best solution to your problem. You will realize what to focus on to improve the situation.
card_T_30_5oC_A1_text:
Blood, kinship. A solution to the problem depends on relatives: their influence, help, arrival or departure. As a rule, the card refers not to spouses, but to close or distant relatives. The second meaning is “like home”. The matter will become familiar, understandable and comfortable to the person. Perhaps, not straight away, but they’ll like it. In a relationship, partners are close, but there’s no passion between them any more. In relationships with other people, the card means a close contact, a soulmate.

The card is unfavorable in matters of development: a person strives for comfort, and as a result they don’t expand their horizon, avoid new experience and progress. In matters of health, it always means blood. It can also have a negative meaning, for example, when it concerns the outcome of a surgery.
card_T_30_5oC_A1_rec_text: Ask your relatives for help, think how their actions can help in your situation. If possible, make yourself feel more comfortable and warm. Make your home cozy and inviting. Let all the conversations be guided by the feeling of closeness and connection. In matters of development, get out of your comfort zone, take new actions for growth.
card_T_30_5oC_A1_aspect: The specific aspect in esoteric spreads: the mother of the kin. This extremely rare meaning points out that the issue involves family programs. Most often it concerns sudden difficulties, unplanned situations. These tasks feel like a burden. It is difficult to solve them but there is an inner feeling that you have to do this. Recommendation: solve the problem of the kin, no matter how difficult it may be. The kin has chosen you to tackle this issue, so you can definitely deal with it.
card_T_31_5oW_D1_text:
New actions in the direction of changes that a person has recently made or is making right now. Before that, there was a calm period of routine and stability, and now with these actions, they turn their life around and move to a new level. A lot of things are changing, so the card might cause fear, a sense of risk, anticipation. It can also mean a conversation, after which nothing will be the same. The card does not promise that you will be able to complete what you started. It depends on your courage and the decision to go all the way to change your life for the better.

The only situation when the card can be negative is if a person is fed up with their routine, and is trying to break out of it too early, doing the wrong things. For example, they leave their family, drop out of school, although now is not the best moment to do it, they need to wait. To clarify the meaning, it is better to do additional spreads.
card_T_31_5oW_D1_rec_text: You are in a transitional moment when the usual way of life is not possible anymore. Take brave actions to break free from boredom and routine. You are ready to change your life.
card_T_31_5oW_A1_text:
A person took a step towards changes, but reconsidered and turned back. They stopped an important action without completing it, or even pretending they didn’t do anything at all. Perhaps, the person was controlled by fear and didn't want to take risks. The emotional color of the card is inner dissatisfaction with yourself that triggers either self-pity (an attempt to blame others for your troubles), or self-flagellation (persuading yourself of your own inferiority and inability to do something).

One possible reaction is an attempt to convince yourself that these actions are not needed, everything is fine as it is. At this stage, there is still an opportunity to complete the process and reach a new level but each next attempt will make it more difficult.
card_T_31_5oW_A1_rec_text: You are trying to run away and back down. Don't do that. Complete the actions that are necessary for changing your life for the better.
card_T_32_4oP_D1_text:
The minimum level of money and energy. This is the amount of income when one has enough money only for the essentials. A person lives from paycheck to paycheck. The business neither pays off, nor makes a profit. One can't save up money: something happens and they have to spend the saved money, or their income gets even less.

In questions about work, the card says that you will not be able to make good money. The minimum energy level implies that you only have energy for basic needs, necessary minimum of tasks and actions. There is no energy left for creativity, joy, pleasure, enjoyment of life. In the spreads about health — the body has neither strength nor energy, it is susceptible to disease. In relationship matters, it means that partners stay together as they are used to each other. Their union is boring, there is no energy, spark, or passion.

In an esoteric sense, the Four of Pentacles means that destiny is unhappy with a person, since they are capable of more. The card can characterize a certain period of life, or the whole life.
card_T_32_4oP_D1_rec_text: You do not want to invest energy, so you get only the minimum. Those who wait but do nothing are doomed to a mundane life. If you want everything to change, take action, invest strength and energy — it will pay off, if not in this area, then in another.
card_T_32_4oP_A1_text: Improving the situation at the energy level. The card shows some positive dynamics: the amount of money increases, its source gets stronger, and the level of energy grows. In a relationship partners start showing more interest in each other, that’s a new stage for them. The card is favorable health wise — the energy of the physical body grows.
card_T_32_4oP_A1_rec_text: Keep doing the right things and investing your efforts to improve your life. You are on the right track.
card_T_33_4oS_D1_text:
The calm time according to destiny. The moment has come when you need to stop and wait. It’s not the time for actions, they will not bring the desired results. The card is perceived negatively, as a person puts in a lot of effort but it doesn't pay off. Everything in life stops, no important events happen. During such periods the head is empty. There is no plan, so any actions are chaotic and useless.

The second meaning is an obstacle. It seems that something is standing in the way and one has to take action to overcome it. However, actions do not bring any results. The arrival of the Four of Swords in the spread means that these obstacles are designed to stop a person. They will only waste their energy on something that will not work anyway.
card_T_33_4oS_D1_rec_text: It’s not the right time for your question. Now you need to make a pause. Do not take active actions, do not try to overcome any obstacles. Switch your attention to another area.
card_T_33_4oS_A1_text: A person tries to resist destiny and take action when it is necessary not to do anything. They are trying to overcome obstacles, but do not achieve any results.
card_T_33_4oS_A1_rec_text: Stop and calm down. Your attempts won’t be successful, you will only lose your energy. Accept this calm period in life sent by destiny and it will do you good.
card_T_34_4oC_D1_text: Failed expectations. Most often, this is an answer to a specific question: everything will turn out not the way a person thinks. Inner ideas about the situation do not coincide with reality. Perhaps, deep down, one does not know how to act in order to get what they want. What they believe will work doesn't bring results, and there is no new plan yet. In a relationship, the card can mean high expectations.
card_T_34_4oC_D1_rec_text: Be ready for the fact that everything will not turn out the way you imagined.
card_T_34_4oC_D2_text: Thoughts are all over the place. A person seemed to be stuck in one situation. They are constantly in the process of experiencing and discussing it. In such a state, they are not looking for a way out, therefore they do not see any possible solutions. They are not ready to act. The card can be fine for short periods of life. The main thing is to go through it on time and continue to act.
card_T_34_4oC_D2_rec_text: Finish this period of life and move on to the next stage of development.
card_T_34_4oC_A1_text: Self-deception, self-soothing, pseudo-optimism. Faced with failed expectations, a person starts convincing themselves that it is okay. They compare their situation to people who are doing even worse, in their opinion. In this state, the person does not take any action, does not want to change anything — only complains and suffers. The card says that the person needs to wait for the moment when they are ready for changes.
card_T_34_4oC_A1_rec_text: Look for ways to get out of stagnation and move to the next level. This approach will not help you improve your life.
card_T_34_4oC_A1_aspect: Specific aspect: in rare cases, the card can have a positive meaning, when nothing can be changed in the situation. You need to hold up and wait for it to end. Better find some advantages and persuade yourself to be patient. But this should never replace a desire to change for the better. Recommendation: try to pay attention to the positive aspects until you can change everything.
card_T_35_4oW_D1_text: Stability, boredom, routine. A simple, uncomplicated, daily pattern of external circumstances. In work matters, this is the level of a “doer” whose actions must be accurate and quick. The work is boring and monotonous, there is no room for creativity. In a relationship, it means external routine, split responsibilities and no freedom. As for a person’s character, the card says that one is extremely predictable and not well-rounded, and their mindset is simple and obvious. The card can be positive when it comes either to training where one needs to follow instructions and other people's rules, or to a start of any process implying developing new skills. The card can appear at a certain life stage but it does not characterize life as a whole.
card_T_35_4oW_D1_rec_text: Get away from a boring scenario. It makes your life monotonous and stops you from growing. If you need to learn something, acquire new skills — make a plan of daily activities and stick to it.
card_T_35_4oW_A1_text: An outlet, passion, hobby that brightens up your routine. The card can be positive if a hobby is a good way out of the situation and makes life a little better. However, the card is more often negative and it means an escape from reality, lack of seriousness. A person is not going to change their life, so they come up with something to get distracted. Often this card means a mistress or lover. Work wise, a person is not ready to improve their position, so they find something positive to hold on to.
card_T_35_4oW_A1_rec_text: In specific questions — find something that will bring you joy. Take up a hobby, start a joint business so that it brings you closer. In deep, significant spreads — do not look for an outlet. You need to radically change your life and move on. Don't be afraid of changes.
card_T_36_JUS_D1_text:
A specific problem in life. It arose because a person was putting off solving some unpleasant tasks and ignored them. As a result, destiny puts them in such a situation when it is no longer possible to hide and run away from these tasks. The problem leads to another, tying the karmic knot. The more the person waits, the more difficult it will be to fix the situation. If they manage to solve the problem of Justice, they will get lots of energy and luck from the Ace of Pentacles.

The specific aspect when the meaning fits the question: problems with the law, prison. A person becomes so dangerous for the social egregore that it isolates them with the help of the most powerful tool.
card_T_36_JUS_D1_rec_text: Don't run away from solving the problem. Think about how you can do it. Work on Justice. If you manage to do that, you will enjoy great success.
card_T_36_JUS_D1_aspect: The specific aspect in the questions concerning official documents: social egregore. When a group of people are united by a common idea, and their joint energy forms an independent unit and starts existing separately. This is how an egregore is born — an energy structure that controls all the processes within a group that formed it. For example, the religious egregore, the egregore of nationality, the social egregore. By doing certain things, people can fit into a particular egregore. For example, christening, wedding — fitting into the christian egregor, marriage, signing official papers, contracts — entering the social egregor. Each egregors has special requirements that must be met. When people do the right actions, follow the rules, and bring benefits to their egregore, it supports and shares its energy with them. However, if someone breaks the rules, the egregore shuns them, and there can be problems and difficulties. The conflict with the social egregor leads to problems with state structures and services. Recommendation: follow the rules of the social egregor. Draw up the documents, conclude an agreement, certify signatures — do everything officially and properly.
card_T_36_JUS_A1_text: Feeling like a victim. Instead of solving problems, a person gets lost in their own illusions. They try to absolve themselves of responsibilities and blame someone else: people around, circumstances, the universe. However, the card says that this position is wrong — the only person who is responsible for everything happening in your life is you.
card_T_36_JUS_A1_rec_text: Stop feeling like a victim. Accept your responsibility and deal with your problems.
card_T_36_JUS_A1_aspect: The specific aspect in matters concerning official documents: unwillingness to enter the social egregor, to do things officially. Recommendation: an attempt to avoid formalities can anger the social egregor or even make it to shun you. It is better to act according to its rules, so that social egregor gives you energy and support.
card_T_37_DTH_D1_text:
Pause, silence, all the processes are slowing down. In regards to the question, there is now a calm period without any significant events. The card is similar to the Hermit card, however the Hermit implies a pause created by the higher powers to move to a new level, while Death means a pause aimed at solving internal problems. Destiny waits for a person to make a choice that will determine the further development of events. They need to understand what they want. It’s not necessary to describe the ideal future in detail.
