Describes the character of a man. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The King of Pentacles is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. Most often, he is calm, does not show what hurt him, but makes conclusions and distances himself, disappears from a person’s field. After that it is difficult to get close to him again and to earn his forgiveness.

Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Pentacles in a particular situation.
card_T_56_KiP_A2_rec_text: Most often cards say that you are being too cold. Don’t be distant, be more gentle. But sometimes they advise to leave, not to take part in this matter. The meaning depends on the question and the context of the situation.
card_T_56_KiP_A3_text: King not in a flow state. A man does not hear his intuition and acts contrary to it. His actions are wrong, he is not able to grasp the situation and understand what is happening. This can be his typical problem, or a particular period in her life.
card_T_56_KiP_A3_rec_text: Learn to listen to your intuition, develop it.
card_T_57_8oW_D1_text:
A situation when you need to make a quick choice. It can radically change the course of your life. The card appears when a person wants to get to the next higher level because the current one does not satisfy them any longer. It is a test of destiny — is a person really ready for radical changes? There comes a new opportunity, offer, and information. However, there is only a day to make a decision.

If a person chooses new opportunities, then they pass the test and show that they are ready to move forward. It is not guaranteed that everything will turn out favorably in terms of the question they asked — this offer may not live up to their expectations. Nevertheless, the main thing is that they reached a new level and started making positive changes in their life. After this, everything will work out in their favor.

If the person hesitates and eventually gives up the opportunity, it won't have any negative consequences. Destiny understands they are not ready yet, so it has to wait. However, if you refuse offers several times in a row, that will bring negative karma — fear hinders your development.

The third option: if the person waited for too long to make a choice and agreed only a day later. Anyway, fate starts moving towards positive changes but in unfavorable conditions. There are some difficulties that cropped up and could have been avoided if the decision had been made quickly. It takes more effort.

Also, there might be not an external, but an internal choice — how the person will react to a certain situation. Can they take a fresh look at the world or are they going to act as they are used to? Destiny is testing if the person is ready for the next level.
card_T_57_8oW_D1_rec_text: Make your choice quickly, without hesitation. Choose a new path, new opportunities — they will bring you some great life improvements.
card_T_57_8oW_A1_text:
A process that must be left behind but a person has delayed making a choice and now they are stuck in it. They did not make a decision when it was necessary, so now things are only getting worse. One might get fired, have a break-up, quit a project or end communication with someone. Things escalate quickly and seem to push the person out of the process. When they finally leave, there follows a period of emptiness and lack of options. They missed an opportunity and have to wait for the next one.

The card can mean either a period of aggravation of the situation, or a period of calm. The reversed Eight of Wands can be favorable when the person needs this period of silence in order to be alone, to reevaluate things and realize something. Then there will be positive cards near the Eight of Wands in the spread that are saying that it is the right thing to do now.
card_T_57_8oW_A1_rec_text: Do not delay processes that are long overdue. Get out of them before the situation starts to get worse. If you experience a period of calm, then wait for the next opportunity.
card_T_58_8oC_D1_text:
Feeling lost, confused. A person tries to get clarity and a better understanding of the situation but they do not succeed. They want to divide everything into good and bad, but already notice the diversity of the world, advantages and disadvantages. It is difficult for them to define the status, role, attitude, put a clear label, see things in black and white. It feels hard, incomprehensible and uncomfortable.

However, the Eight of Cups is a card of wisdom. It does not force you to make a quick decision. This is an important period of development you need to experience in order to learn to see all the aspects of life and accept them.
card_T_58_8oC_D1_rec_text: Be in the wisdom card. Realize all the advantages and disadvantages and learn to think wider. It is not necessary to decide something or set clear boundaries now.
card_T_58_8oC_A1_text: A person resists, struggles with themselves, tries to get clarity. They are always tense, trying to make a choice but nothing comes of it.
card_T_58_8oC_A1_rec_text: You want to see things in black and white but it is impossible in the current situation — it is neither good nor bad. Learn wisdom and acceptance.
card_T_59_8oS_D1_text:
The situation doesn’t develop according to plan. A person acts as they are used to but this time it does not lead to the expected result. For example, they talk with their partner in the same manner but end up falling out. Or they use proven methods at work but face difficulties. It causes anger, irritation, and despair.

The card seems heavy and negative, but it teaches an important lesson. It points out the illusion that everything depends on a person. However, in this situation no matter how carefully they calculate their moves or consider all possible options, things will not go the way they want. In fact, everything happens in a new way but not necessarily a bad one. From destiny’s point of view, things go the way they should.
card_T_59_8oS_D1_rec_text: Relax and accept the situation as it is. Don't try to fight destiny. Consider the circumstances. If the question is about the future, be ready for the fact that everything might not go according to your plan and bring different results.
card_T_59_8oS_A1_text: A person resists destiny and tries to do everything in their own way. They keep acting the old way, but it does not work anymore, so they put too much effort and go too far, thereby harming themselves.
card_T_59_8oS_A1_rec_text: Accept your destiny and do not resist, it will not bring results.
card_T_60_8oP_D1_text:
The emergence of a tempting opportunity that will lead a person to their dream. But to seize it, one needs to give up something stable and familiar in life.

Such an opportunity comes to the person when deep down they realize they want something different, real, not socially significant (a purpose — not a career, a soulmate — not someone who feels convenient to be with). Destiny sends them this opportunity to check whether they are ready to follow their dream. At the same time, there are no guarantees that everything will work out, anyway one should give up the old first, so the card implies taking a risk. It is not clear whether it will be possible to set up their own business, but one needs to quit their current job right now. No one knows whether a new relationship will work out, but in order to try, one needs to break off the old one.

If the person decides to take a risk and chooses their dream, they show their readiness for a new level. And then, even if this opportunity does not bring results, they will start moving towards the dream.
card_T_60_8oP_D1_rec_text: Think carefully about whether you are willing to take risks. Take a wise decision. The card does not promise that the situation will turn out fine, it only gives you some information. From destiny’s point of view, you should not be afraid to follow your dream. But it is up to you anyway.
card_T_60_8oP_A1_text:
A person decides not to follow their dream, and someone else fulfills their dream instead. The opportunity comes to those who are not afraid to take risks, and often they are less worthy of it. The situation undermines the person’s ambitions, pride, and makes them regret. It is especially painful in the case of their personal life. This is a lesson of destiny that teaches us to make the right conclusions and take risks next time.

Also, the card can mean the arrival of another opportunity after the one a person refused to take. But now all the fears that made them change their mind will come true. On the way to their dream, the person will have to face all the problems, failures and negative thoughts they imagined. It is going to be a difficult path not everyone can go till the end. But if they do not give up and overcome the obstacles, they will achieve their dream — the card guarantees this.
card_T_60_8oP_A1_rec_text: Decide whether you are ready to face all the difficulties for the sake of your dream. If not, don't try. But if you are determined to take a chance, then do not look back and go till the end.
card_T_61_TMP_D1_text: The process of ripening. From the outside, it may seem that nothing is happening but in reality, there is a slow, smooth movement. Events follow each other almost imperceptibly. There is steady development. Maybe one is going through a process of internal preparation. The person should not worry about the feeling of stagnation and silence, as their fears are unfounded — everything moves at its own pace.
card_T_61_TMP_D1_rec_text: Keep doing what you did and wait. Let the events take their course. Now is not the time for active action and ventures.
card_T_61_TMP_D1_aspect: The specific aspect in questions concerning relationships: natural partnership. Two people complement each other perfectly in all aspects of life. This is a good card for friendship and business cooperation. But if the question is about a romantic relationship, a couple might have lost passion and spark. Their relationship revolves around family, life, children, but not each other. Recommendation: be in a natural partnership. Try to bring new emotions into your relationship with your loved one.
card_T_61_TMP_A1_text: It is time for active action. Now the process of ripening and assimilation is replaced by a period of growth, development, dynamics, and major changes. One can already see the first results.
card_T_61_TMP_A1_rec_text: Take action, start new processes, develop old ones, make changes and adjustments.
card_T_61_TMP_A1_aspect: Specific aspect in questions concerning relationships: resistance to the natural partnership. Instead of uniting, people fight, argue, create a conflict of interests. Recommendation: reach a consensus and restore the natural partnership. Together you will achieve much more impressive results.
card_T_62_DVL_D1_text: Addictions. Everything that deprives a person of their free will, conscious choice. They rely not on their true desires, deepest needs, feelings, but on addictions. The person subconsciously adjusts their decisions to them. Everyone has their own addictions: people, work, money, behavior, public opinion, children, food, alcohol, smoking, and so on. Even addiction to something positive (healthy lifestyle, sports) is harmful in a global sense. All of them take away one’s right to free will given from above and one is punished by fate for them. The person has to face tough circumstances, problems, and negative situations to overcome their addiction. It puts them in a difficult position, brings discomfort and anguish.
card_T_62_DVL_D1_rec_text: Become aware of your addictions and, if possible, get rid of them. They don't have to rule your life.
card_T_62_DVL_D1_aspect:
The specific aspect in questions concerning work, finance: money in a negative context. This can be a loss or lack of money, difficulties in relationships because of it, low income, expenses. Recommendation: sort out your financial problems.

The specific aspect in certain questions: sex as a purely physiological process that does not necessarily imply feelings. The cards either point out that the topic is important for a person or shows sex peculiarities — problematic, crazy, adrenergic. Recommendation: direct your attention to the sexual side.
card_T_62_DVL_A1_text:
A person is on the verge of getting addicted but has not crossed the line yet. The Devil already sees but can’t control them. The situation is getting worse.

The specific aspect in particular questions: coincides with the specific aspect of the upright card.
card_T_62_DVL_A1_rec_text: Stop now, you can still avoid addiction. Focus on it and take action so as not to face the Devil.
card_T_63_TWR_D1_text:
Losses, destruction of the old. There is something that should be left in the past, but a person holds on to it and is not ready to let it go. If so, the Tower comes to them and takes it away by force. One loses their job, breaks up relationships, their valuable possessions disappear, technical devices break down. The Tower always takes only what has already become obsolete and is no longer needed. It cleans up the old and makes room for a new stage that is ready to start. But the person is not aware of this, so the card feels very painful.

One can try to redirect the energy of the Tower to destroy not the process itself, but the circumstances that interfere with it. In a relationship, for example, to remove something that makes people grow apart and go through a rough patch. But resisting the Tower is useless — it will still make room for the new.

Also, the Tower comes to those who made the wrong choice at the Lovers card.
card_T_63_TWR_D1_rec_text: Let the Tower take what it's time to let go from your life. This is an inevitable process of renewal.
card_T_63_TWR_A1_text: A person tries to resist the Tower and hold onto the past at any cost. It's time to let go, to leave, but they want to avoid losses, as they are afraid of changes.
card_T_63_TWR_A1_rec_text: Relax and give the Tower what no longer belongs to you.
card_T_64_STR_D1_text:
Meaning for important esoteric spreads. Сall, intuition. It is an inner feeling of irrational, intuitive attraction to something. A person feels the desire they can’t explain logically at first. Later, they start looking for the arguments to explain it with their mind, but the inner feeling is primary. The call works at the level of such high vibrations that a person may not be even aware of it. They only feel the desire to do something and understand that they have to follow this feeling.

The call always leads in the right direction and supports creation. But sometimes, to create something new, one has to destroy something old. The person feels it is time for changes, fulfilling wishes, so they quit their job, cut old ties. They always have a good reason to act like this.
card_T_64_STR_D1_rec_text: Follow the call, it will bring important events into your life.
card_T_64_STR_D2_text: Meaning for everyday questions. Low self-esteem that provokes unnatural behavior. A person is trying to pretend to be someone they are not. They can also be too active making a lot of unnecessary fuss. This is an unconscious attempt to compensate for inner insecurity. It looks fake and only creates distrust.
card_T_64_STR_D2_rec_text: Don't behave like that. You think that it will help you to achieve what you want, but in fact it looks unnatural. Work on your self-esteem.
card_T_64_STR_A1_text: Meaning for important esoteric spreads. Resistance to the call. A person hears it, but can’t explain it with their mind, so they talk themselves out of following it. They either decide that it is not the time, or try to change the conditions and replace the call with an alternative option. But the energy was given to complete a certain task, so they lose their motivation soon and face difficulties.
card_T_64_STR_A1_rec_text: Stop resisting, follow your intuition. The lowest meaning in specific, everyday matters: low self-esteem that comes out as arrogance. A person considers themselves better than others, asserts themselves at their expense, keeps distance and does want to cooperate. Everyone can behave like this when it comes to certain matters. Such behavior stems from lack of confidence.
card_T_64_STR_A2_text: Meaning for everyday questions. Low self-esteem that comes out as arrogance. A person considers themselves better than others, asserts themselves at their expense, keeps distance and does want to cooperate. Everyone can behave like this when it comes to certain matters. Such behavior stems from lack of confidence.
card_T_64_STR_A2_rec_text: Realize the moments when you behave arrogantly and try to fix such behavior. Do not cut ties with other people as it seems they are not able to understand you — often this is not the case.
card_T_65_9oW_D1_text: Obstacles one has to overcome. Destiny wants a person to make efforts and grow energetically. These obstacles are always surmountable, so there are things that depend entirely on the person, they might be able to influence them. It is time to take action and do your best, then the situation improves and starts moving towards a positive outcome. Sometimes the obstacles seem insignificant, as if they are meant to distract the person from their goal. One realizes they have a lot of small errands to do, which takes all their attention and time. The main thing here is to overcome this impulse and focus on the main thing. If a person overcomes all the challenges, the success of the Ten of Wands will await them.
card_T_65_9oW_D1_rec_text: Overcome obstacles. Make an effort and destiny will lead you to a favorable outcome.
card_T_65_9oW_A1_text: Obstacles come up in someone else’s life. It can be a family member, friend, acquaintance, often a child or a pet. Something happens to them and that can affect a person's decision, preventing them from doing what they planned. It might happen that a person themselves becomes such an obstacle, when their inner subpersonality is against their decision. In such a situation, it is important not to respond to provocation, though it is often difficult in case of close people.
card_T_65_9oW_A1_rec_text: Overcome this obstacle. Come to an agreement, find another solution, but finish what you started and reach your goal.
card_T_66_9oC_D1_text:
High-level love. The ability to love, fully accept a partner just the way they are, without illusions and expectations. To be aware of their merits and demerits without trying to change them. This is creative love when a person invests in their partner because they want to do it, it makes them happy. They support the efforts of their loved one to become better because it is important for them. You can approve or disapprove of your partner's actions but love them anyway.

If the question does not concern romantic relationships, then the card means moving in the right direction, love and support from God. In general, the card describes the highest level of attitude towards the world, nature, friends, and people around. The ability to love, invest oneself and totally accept things.

It is impossible to always live in the consciousness of the Nine of Cups — one will face internal contradictions, beliefs, conflicts anyway. They determine the development of a person. But if they reach this level once, they can get back to it.
card_T_66_9oC_D1_rec_text: Allow yourself love at the highest level — you are ready for it.
card_T_66_9oC_A1_text: A feeling that one invests more than they get back. A person is doing their best but does not feel it pays off. There are two possible options here: either they really do not get what they deserve, or they get it but in a different form. Their efforts pay off in such a way that they do not understand or appreciate. Expectations don’t let them see the real picture.
card_T_66_9oC_A1_rec_text: Try to change your perception and see everything you actually get for your efforts. Probably, you should try to re-establish some contacts to restore the balance. If it is impossible and your kindness is not appreciated, then leave.
card_T_67_9oS_D1_text:
Deep acceptance. This is the highest level of thinking, perception of events and life in general, the result of a long development of the mind. First, destiny teaches a person to be in sync with the Seven of Swords: to create their own reality, take responsibility, make plans and realize them. Then it gets them through the Eight of Swords, when everything does not go according to plan and the proven methods do not work anymore. If the person learns these lessons, they reach the level of the Nine of Swords. It is an understanding that not everything in the world can be controlled since there are other factors.

There is destiny, there is God's will. The person knows that a lot depends on them: they know how to act, take responsibility, try and achieve. But at the same time, they realize that there can be any result, that’s why there is no point in holding on to it. So, one accepts any course of events and admits that there is a higher purpose behind it — this is how it should be.
card_T_67_9oS_D1_rec_text: Perceive events at the highest level of thinking. Do whatever depends on you and be as it may.
card_T_67_9oS_D1_aspect: Specific aspect for certain questions: it’s meant to be. What was meant to happen is happening now. These events are inevitable because of the actions of the people involved. They created this turn of life themselves. Recommendation: accept it as it is your destiny.
card_T_67_9oS_A1_text: One can't accept what is happening. There occur difficult, unfair events that totally confuse one’s way of thinking at the level of the Nine of Swords. This is an inevitable path to acceptance that must be taken.
card_T_67_9oS_A1_rec_text: Try to accept what is happening. Work with acceptance.
card_T_67_9oS_A1_aspect: Specific aspect for certain questions: it’s not meant to be. Due to some actions, this path is not available for you now. Perhaps, if you change your behavior, it can become possible again after some time. Recommendation: accept that it is not meant to happen at this stage.
card_T_68_9oP_D1_text:
The right actions from the point of view of the mission, which provides a high level of energy and money. Although the energy flow is not as powerful as at the Seven of Pentacles, there is exactly as much energy as needed. One has enough energy for all their undertakings, it comes in and distributes evenly among the things that have to be done. At this level, the person almost never feels a lack of energy, there is no need to recharge the batteries. In terms of health, it means wellness.

There may be less money at the Nine of Pentacles than at the Seven, but the quality and standard of living is definitely higher due to other things that can’t be bought. Money comes in for specific tasks and exactly as much as needed. The person gets the rest with the help of other resources, gifts, prizes, connections. In general, the level of the Nine of Pentacles implies living in the flow. When the person listens to the higher powers and works for them, their intuition is well-developed, and they enjoy a whirlwind of good events. Everything works out well, and one knows how to make the best out of things.

In a relationship, the card means true partnership. A couple have similar life values, worldview, approximately the same energy level and emotional state. People can be different, but they are perfect for each other at all levels. The card says the couple have perfect relationships now. They resonate like true partners.
card_T_68_9oP_D1_rec_text: Be in the flow. Keep on acting and making your life better, now there are favorable circumstances for it. Trust your feelings. Do what gives you energy. In terms of relationship, be in true partnership, open yourself up to it.
card_T_68_9oP_A1_text:
The wrong distribution of energy and money. A person begins to invest themselves into something new and suddenly faces some problems. The energy was given for one thing, but they got distracted and directed it into something else, so they got disconnected from the flow. For example, one was planning to set up a business, but when they finally had resources for this, they decided to renovate their house. In money matters, it can be financial help to the people who were not supposed to be helped: destiny taught them important lessons with the aid of money, but the person interfered and got cut off from the resource flow.

Also, the card can mean the appearance of a “causal vampire” in one’s life: these are processes, things or people that take time, energy and money. The person wastes their resources and gets nothing in return. Such activities imply no development, movement, or exchange of energy. It can be a formal communication you waste your time on because it would be impolite to refuse to talk. Or hobbies that distract from real life.

In relationships, the reversed Nine of Pentacles is a potential true partner. People can reach this level, but they still need to grow, work, and take steps towards the goal together. It may lead to the fact that one of the partners feels they are perfect for each other, invests in their relationship, but their efforts don’t seem to pay off. They expect development and positive changes, but in the end there is only hope and false expectations.
card_T_68_9oP_A1_rec_text: Stop, you are going in the wrong direction. You are putting your energy and money into the wrong processes. If there is a “causal vampire”, get rid of them — they are taking away your resources. When it comes to relationships, try to set a deadline for investing as much as possible and try to take the relationship to the next level. And then make up your conclusions. If there are no changes, end this relationship — it will not lead to a perfect partnership.
card_T_69_MON_D1_text: Fears. Most often these are deep subconscious programs. They can stem from personal experience or family programs, even past lives. They are irrational and beyond our control. The card means that the process is blocked by internal fears you may not even be aware of.
card_T_69_MON_D1_rec_text: Don't rely on the Moon in this matter. Your fear controls you. Focus your energy on finding and fighting your fear.
card_T_69_MON_D2_text: Illusions, false perception of reality. A person misunderstands the situation and starts reading too much into it. They get all worked up and come up with explanations. Most people do that sometimes. The card may also point out the beginning of mental health problems.
card_T_69_MON_D2_rec_text: Do not read too much into it. It is better to ask again, clarify, double-check the information. It’s highly likely that you are just overthinking too much.
card_T_69_MON_A1_text: Fears that do not truly belong to us. They can be born from two sources: from the outside or from the inside. External fears arise from other people who trigger them, making them more intense. One constantly deals with negative information, and it stays in their subconsciousness in the form of fear. It can also be a feeding frenzy in the society, mass hysteria, which only intensifies fears. An internal source is when one hears a voice of their family member or relatives inside. The fear belonged to them, but the person communicated with them so often that in the end this fear became their own. To understand the source of your fear, you need to ask the cards clarifying questions.
card_T_69_MON_A1_rec_text: Don't act out of fear. Find its source. If it's someone outside, then distance yourself, break off this contact, set boundaries. Or deal with inner fears that don't belong to you.
card_T_69_MON_A2_text: Wrong ideas that came from the outside. Someone made a person believe in this illusion. They trusted their words and got sidetracked.
card_T_69_MON_A2_rec_text: Stop, don't get so worked up. What you have heard is not true. Double-check this information.
card_T_70_SUN_D1_text:
The perfect harmony of the external and internal. Requests, desires and the character of a person fit perfectly into external circumstances. There emerge the right circumstances for the person to be their true self. The person gets what they asked for, so the Sun can be called a card of happiness. In terms of character, the card speaks of a well-balanced personality that doesn’t have a lot of internal contradictions.

The negative side of this card is that it is unstable and short-term as well as depends a lot on the circumstances. Any changes, either external or internal, will destroy the harmony. Desires and priorities are changing.

In terms of relationships, the card indicates the person one can create a family with. In spite of the changing circumstances, it’s highly likely that the couple will manage to maintain and strengthen their relationship.
card_T_70_SUN_D1_rec_text: You have everything you need to fulfill your wishes. Take the necessary steps to achieve the perfect harmony.
card_T_70_SUN_A1_text:
Fixing negative karma. A person does everything right but some time ago they created negative karma, that’s why they can not see any results of their actions yet. They are doing their best but it doesn’t pay because everything is focused on balancing their karma. Only when it turns into a plus, they will see all the results and benefits they got and realize that their wishes have come true.

For example, the person has been long hesitating whether to take the opportunity to set up their own business, and that created subtracted their karma. As a result, they finally made up their mind and started a business, but it is not thriving and does not make profit. There is the process of fixing negative karma. If the person does not give up and keeps on trying, then they will get everything they want in the end — behind the reversed Sun there always hides success. But it is impossible to say how long it will take to achieve it. You have to believe in it.

In terms of relationships, there might be the potential for their development. But for this you need to go through a rough patch together, to adapt to each other if necessary. If people invest in their relationship and do their best, eventually they will find their happiness.

As for character, the person has to do a lot of inner work on themselves in order to start showing their true self in a more harmonious way. Perhaps there are a lot of traumas and complexes to deal with.
card_T_70_SUN_A1_rec_text: Keep acting and investing your energy. This process definitely has real potential, it just takes time.
card_T_71_JUD_D1_text: A significant upgrade, a leap to a new level in the area the question was about. This is a beautiful, powerful period in life when a person is improving their quality of life. There are important positive changes happening. One has a lot of energy they manage to realize. The transition to Judgement is going on comfortably and under favorable circumstances. It has tremendous potential, however people rarely realize it to the fullest because of their fears or excessive caution.
card_T_71_JUD_D1_rec_text: Use Judgement. Do not be afraid, open up to and trust it. Go bravely into this process relying on the support of fate. If the question is about the future, wait for the Judgement, you will need the most favorable circumstances and the help of the higher powers.
card_T_71_JUD_A1_text: Here comes the period of Judgement but a person resists it and tries to take something old into a new life. They feel that it is time to let it go, but their old habits and fear play their part and slow down the person. These can be people, circumstances, old conditions and programs, manners and habits, and attitude towards the issue. They are no longer relevant and therefore do not let the person enter the new reality. Destiny will force them to give up the old and get Judgement into its upright position.
card_T_71_JUD_A1_rec_text: Give up something old that interferes with your new life and hinders your development.
card_T_72_ToW_D1_text:
A more convenient format of external circumstances. It concerns the social component of life: where a person lives, how they work, how different processes happen in their life, their convenience. Work wise, this can be an improvement in conditions, logistics, format, schedule. It may also mean taking a step up the career ladder. In relationships, the visible part is changing for the better: the atmosphere and behavior, how people communicate with each other, how they interact. Character wise, the person built a new useful habit, their skills improved.

The specific aspect in questions concerning relationships: family, unit of society, official marriage. To develop your relationship, you need to take a step the society will approve of: stop hiding it, start living together, get married — it depends on the starting point of the relationship. The card advises to change the social format.

The specific aspect in questions about specific objects: the thing you asked about. The cards call the item the Ten of Wands, and other cards in the spread will characterize it.

card_T_72_ToW_D1_rec_text: You have everything to make your life more comfortable. Take a step up.
card_T_72_ToW_A1_text: A person can already behave in a new way, but still does not let themselves do so. There were some positive changes, they got a new status. card_T_72_ToW_A1_rec_text: Get used to your new status and change your behavior in accordance with it.
card_T_73_ToC_D1_text: An abrupt change in attitude. A person found out something —heard or saw, and their attitude changed. The card only indicates the fact of the change, but to understand if it is for the better or worse, one should take into account either the circumstances of the question, or other cards. It is impossible to treat another person or see a situation as before. Also, the card can mean a new level of feeling — the appearance of a feeling that one has never had before. Often it arises from important events such as finding love, the birth of children, the loss of a loved one.
card_T_73_ToC_D1_rec_text: Accept the change in your attitude. Allow yourself to feel different, be in sync with this experience, live through it.
card_T_73_ToC_A1_text: A slow change in attitude. A person observes, learns more information, and their attitude is slowly changing for the better, worse or getting neutral. This card is not about major changes.
card_T_73_ToC_A1_rec_text: Let your attitude change as the situation unfolds.
card_T_74_ToS_D1_text:
Loss, destruction. A person had plans, but something happened and destroyed them. It didn't turn out the way they imagined. It feels extremely painful like a loss of something important. It is difficult for the person to come to terms with it, they weep over their unfulfilled hopes. The card points out that the plan was unfeasible from the very beginning. Destiny made it possible to move in this direction, because there was an impulse. But when it became clear that the path won’t benefit the person, it cut it off.

The specific aspect in questions about health: surgery, cutting something off, amputation.
card_T_74_ToS_D1_rec_text: Do not resist, accept the reality and make new plans.
card_T_74_ToS_A1_text:
Loss, destruction that a person caused themselves. They understand that there is no point following the same path, so they decide to get out of it. They abandon the plans they made earlier. This is the right choice, but it feels painful and hard.

The specific aspect in questions about health: a small surgery.
card_T_74_ToS_A1_rec_text: Stop following this path, no matter how difficult it is.
card_T_75_ToP_D1_text:
A higher level of energy or money. There appears something that increases a person’s strength, allows them to both invest more and get more in return. Their income is increasing.

Particular aspect in questions about relationships: energy relationships. This is a feeling of unity in a couple, inner fullness, a subtle feeling of each other.

The specific aspect in questions about a one-time situation: a one-time increase in energy or money. It can be a lottery win, a prize, or a grant. Or any kind of one-time action that boosted a person’s energy.
card_T_75_ToP_D1_rec_text: Do something that will lead you to a higher level of energy or money. You are capable of this.
card_T_75_ToP_A1_text: When spread has more positive cards. Ease. Something works out quickly and naturally, one can do it easily and with pleasure. It is favorable in matters of work, hobbies, and communication with other people.
card_T_75_ToP_A1_rec_text: Take it easy. Don't exert yourself, act naturally. You got this.
card_T_75_ToP_A2_text: When spread has more negative cards. Carefree attitude. A person does not consider the situation serious, does not think it is important, and therefore does not make the necessary effort. But destiny expects a more serious attitude and actions from them.
card_T_75_ToP_A2_rec_text: You are being too carefree. Be careful, take it more seriously.
card_T_76_FOL_D1_text:
Courage, audacity. The Fool’s energy relies on the right of free will that was given to a person from above to create their own reality. This is the right to act as you wish, not according to the fate scenario. In its purest form, the Fool’s impulse is always constructive and positive. If the person catches and holds it, they can achieve absolutely everything despite all the laws of logic. They do really brave things and achieve even the impossible goals no matter what.

The Fool instills confidence into the person and persuades them that everything will work out anyway, giving them a healthy and bright drive. Other people often doubt, disapprove, or discourage. The main thing is not to listen to them, not to be afraid and hold your energy inside. With its help, you can radically change your destiny and enter another reality. Due to bold actions and inner faith, the person changes their life. There occur events of a different level and quality. The Fool card has the highest potential for changes as it does not obey any laws — not even destiny.
card_T_76_FOL_D1_rec_text: Go for it. Act boldly, think outside the box, and take risks. If you have the courage to reach the end without looking back at other people, doubts, failures, then you can change your reality. But if you are not ready to take risks and keep on going in spite of everything, don’t start at all — there may be a lot of challenges ahead, and it is rather difficult to keep the Fool’s impulse.
card_T_76_FOL_A1_text: Unfavorable circumstances that must be overcome in order to reach the Fool. These are difficulties that have already stopped a person once. They got scared and did not risk it. The next time they decided to take this path again, all the negative things they feared happened. This is a test: if the person has enough determination this time, or they quit and give up again. If one overcomes all the circumstances, they will succeed in the end, a creative impulse of the Fool awaits them. However, there is only a slim chance that they will reach it since the path is very difficult.
card_T_76_FOL_A1_rec_text: Make up your mind — are you ready to overcome all the obstacles to change your life? If you are determined to do this, then deal with all difficulties without looking back and achieve your goal.
card_T_77_BLA_D1_text:
Divine energy. The higher powers give a person a very powerful flow of pure strength as a reward for following the path of destiny. This is a target energy — it is given to solve a specific task that a person chose themselves. Nevertheless, if they spend it on something else, there will be no negative consequences. Usually it appears in the form of an excellent, interesting opportunity, new information.

The scale of the card depends on the question: in terms of everyday matters, the card means a good chance to deal with this situation. If the question concerns significant moments in life, then the card promises a huge amount of concentrated energy that can help a person to change their destiny. By directing this enormous strength into work, they can create a new reality for themselves.

The specific aspect in the spreads about subjective reality (thoughts, feelings, emotions, people’s plans): self-deception. Other cards in the spread will tell you more details.
card_T_77_BLA_D1_rec_text: Seize a new opportunity. If you try and realize its full potential, you can radically change your life.
card_T_77_BLA_A1_text: The Blank Card always has only one (upright) meaning.
card_T_78_EMR_D1_text: The right actions from the point of view of destiny. A person starts doing something that will eventually lead them in the right direction. The card symbolizes the moment of getting on the right path, so it concerns recent actions, thoughts, and plans. However, it does not promise that everything will turn out exactly the way the person imagines or that they will get what they want. These can be unpleasant events that are favorable anyway from the point of view of higher powers.
card_T_78_EMR_D1_rec_text: Choose evidently right actions that will lead you to your destiny. Deep inside you know what to do.
card_T_78_EMR_A1_text: Leaving the path of doing the right things. A person is thinking about or has already started doing the wrong things from the point of view of destiny. They may seem more logical and favorable in the short run but actually do not fit into the destiny of a person. Therefore, they will face obstacles and difficulties on their way.
card_T_78_EMR_A1_rec_text: Stop, you are moving away from the path of your destiny, going in the wrong direction.
card_T_79_WRL_D1_text:
A state of inner harmony, a resourceful state. The card indicates a high level of energy. A person is in sync with the flows of light in this world. Hence, here comes a state of spiritual clarity and inner structure. One’s life is full of only happy events and good people. There is enough energy for all the necessary things. Any undertakings are going to take off and develop according to the best scenario.

The World card contains the Nine of Cups, the Nine of Swords and the Nine of Pentacles — high-vibration love, total acceptance, the flow. This is a good, beautiful, stable state. However, human nature doesn’t let the person stay in it for a long time, as there are mood swings happening from time to time as well as negative traits that often take over. The more the person strives to return to the state of peace (World), the more fulfilled and harmonious they feel. Also, a similar state can occur during an easy, healthy pregnancy.
card_T_79_WRL_D1_rec_text: Get into the state of peace. Now you can reach and stay in it. Find your inner contact with high vibrations. Meditation, listening to music, and other tools that work for you can help. If the question is about the future, then you need to wait for the state of inner harmony and act out of it.
card_T_79_WRL_A1_text: A person is still in a state of inner harmony, but starts losing it. Something knocked them out of their resourceful state. Most often, it’s the fault of one of the Nines: there was not enough inner love or total acceptance from another person, something shook one’s confidence in the World, fears appeared. If you track down negative patterns and work on them, you can still have high energy.
card_T_79_WRL_A1_rec_text: Try to move from negative vibrations into a state of peace and harmony. If the question concerns something that is done out of resentment, grief, revenge, then the card advises not to do so. In this situation, you lack trust, acceptance, or love.
